display.purpose: Lowercase two-word wordmark; each word is nowrap, with a real separating space and a 20vw cap on the fluid token. Weight 200 stays stable on hover/active.

cover-headline.purpose: Narrower paper-colored headline on the charcoal cover, changing to rose on hover/active at stable weight 300.

section.purpose: Recent-story section and sidebar module headings.

prose.purpose: Sustained article reading at a 70ch maximum.

label.purpose: Metadata and captions; small descriptions retain their actual inherited weight.

note.purpose: Muted supporting notes and specimen disclosures.

navigation.purpose: Inactive muted navigation link at stable weight 300; hover/active changes only color to rose.

navigation-current.purpose: Current page link, distinguished by rose color and weight 600.

utility.purpose: Uppercase publication/specimen information; the entire utility block is hidden at width <= 30rem.

section-label.purpose: Uppercase recent-story count and ordering label.

quote.purpose: Regular quotation text inside a cream field.

list-link.purpose: Supporting-list anchor at weight 600; hover/active uses 700.

code.purpose: Proportional inline code with inherited prose leading.

prose-link.purpose: Inline prose anchor, italic at stable weight 600 in every state, distinct from upright strong text.
prose-link.italicDelivery: Browser synthesis from the single upright Inter asset.

motion.name: interaction-ease
motion.purpose: Easing shared by link-color and destination transitions.

breakpoints.name: narrow-navigation-gap
breakpoints.behavior: Reduce the navigation gap from 1.5rem to 0.5rem, retaining a single native horizontal row.

breakpoints.name: compact-stories
breakpoints.behavior: Hide the publication utility block without reserved space; use 1rem shell margins and stacked recent-story rows with min(6rem, 33.3333%) thumbnail tracks, flexible text tracks, and 1.25rem titles.

breakpoints.name: stacked-cover
breakpoints.behavior: Stack cover copy before the figure.

breakpoints.name: stacked-editorial
breakpoints.behavior: One editorial column; masthead description below wordmark; sidebar after content; inline native article contents replaces sidebar contents.

layout.coverSourceOrder: Copy then optional figure; wide grid puts figure left and copy right.

wordmark.words: Separate nowrap spans with a real space; wrap between words when needed.

focus.css: .una :where(:focus-visible) { outline: var(--una-focus-width) solid var(--una-color-focus); outline-offset: var(--una-focus-offset); }

reducedMotion.behavior: Remove all link-color and article-target background-color transitions.

forcedColors.behavior: Use LinkText for unvisited links, VisitedText for visited links, and Highlight for hover/active/current links and focus outlines. Add no borders or underlines.

skipLink.target: Main landmark with a unique id and tabindex=-1.

navigation.element: One labeled nav containing one set of direct anchors in a non-wrapping horizontal row at every width.
navigation.overflow: Only the navigation strip scrolls horizontally when its links exceed the available width.
navigation.stripPadding: 0.5rem on every side, preserving room for the shared focus outline.
navigation.linkWrapping: Labels remain on one line; links do not shrink.
navigation.scrollPaddingInline: 50%; a centered optimal viewing region for native focus scrolling.
navigation.scrollbar: Hidden with scrollbar-width: none and ::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none }; the partial next label is the overflow cue.
navigation.scrolling: Browser-native horizontal scrolling and momentum; vertical page gestures remain unrestricted.
navigation.keyboard: Tab focuses each ordinary anchor; the centered optimal viewing region guides native scrolling to reveal even a partially visible focused link.
navigation.motion: Link color transitions for 160ms at the shared easing; navigation weight remains stable on hover/active. Native scrolling has no custom animation, snap behavior, or timer.
navigation.current: aria-current=page, accent color, and stable weight 600; no text decoration.
navigation.hoverActive: Inactive links change from muted cocoa to rose while retaining weight 300; current links retain rose and weight 600. Focus keeps its visible outline.

links.default: Reading blue at weight 600, text-decoration none.
links.hoverActive: Ordinary links use accent rose at weight 700; brand, display-title, navigation, and prose-link roles retain their own stable weights.
links.brand: Cocoa to rose at stable weight 200.
links.navigation: Inactive muted cocoa 300 to rose 300; current stays rose 600.
links.displayTitle: Reading blue to rose at stable weight 300; cover uses paper to rose.
links.visited: No separate authored color outside forced-colors mode.
links.focus: Visible outline; no underline or pseudo-element stroke.
links.prose: Reading blue to rose at stable italic weight 600, distinct from upright strong 600.

print.layout: Main content becomes block layout; shell becomes 100% width.
print.colors: Document becomes black on white; cover background and padding are removed, and its metadata/caption inherit the print text color. All links, including visited, hover, and active states, inherit the surrounding print text color.

theming.authority: Root canonical CSS; optional Tailwind @theme inline aliases it.
theming.aliasResolution: Aliases resolve where declared. Override root primitives after core CSS for a coordinated theme; a descendant primitive override does not recompute inherited dependent aliases.
theming.scopedOverride: Redeclare --una-font-display, --una-font-prose, and --una-font-code when overriding --una-font-body in a scope; redeclare --una-color-accent when changing its original-rose source only in that scope.

extensions.previewNotes: Ten existing patterns, with ds- classes and live CSS token references plus source-value fallbacks. Load the optional local font stylesheet for Inter. SVG artwork is inlined from original repository specimens; no external preview asset or framework is needed. Fragment destinations belong to the surrounding document. Inline contents is shown independently of the page breakpoint. Static quotations have no invented hover state. The prose example makes italic links and upright strong text visible together. The masthead example includes utility copy so its phone omission is represented.

fontDelivery.style: Upright normal asset; italic emphasis and prose links use browser synthesis without an extra font download.
fontDelivery.roleOwnership: All four font roles resolve to the body stack at their root declaration; scoped overrides must redeclare dependent aliases.

localFallback.limitations: These measured candidates align x-height and vertical metrics for the indicated optical-size endpoint only. The variable font x-height changes from 1118 at opsz14 to 1056 at opsz32; one fixed fallback cannot match every automatic optical size or glyph width. Arial has no matching true 200/300/500/600 variable faces; weight matching remains approximate. System-ui is an alternative when a predictable weight fallback matters more than metric matching.

narrative.overview:
Una Moderno makes an independent publication feel like a collection worth browsing: large light typography, confident square artwork, compact useful lists, and continuous open space without dividers. Cocoa text and a warm near-white ground surround a charcoal lead-story field. Rose marks navigation state; blue and cream belong to original editorial art and restrained reading cues.

The owner-pinned Zune 4.0 light Collection view supplies the typographic hierarchy, aligned lists, and open canvas. The historical Zune HD website reference supplies the dark lead field within a light document. These principles become an original editorial system, with Inter in every text role and a calm light article surface. The references are evidence, not distributable artwork or a media-player template; their relationship to the implementation is recorded in [the inspiration record](docs/zune-inspiration.md).

Hierarchy comes from weight, scale, leading, and space within one family. The system stays flat and native: ordinary links, a single horizontal navigation strip, semantic headings and lists, and article contents built with disclosure. The charcoal story treatment is a component variant, not a dark theme.
keyCharacteristics: Light lowercase display and navigation typography, with regular-weight sustained reading.
One charcoal lead-story field, square cover art, and open supporting lists on a continuous light ground.
Unequal editorial columns with one 20px gutter, followed by a source-order stack on narrow screens.
Inter across all text roles; prose remains bounded by a 70ch maximum.
Native scrolling and visible focus, with brief link-color and article-target transitions that respect reduced motion.

rules.name: The Useful Color Rule
rules.body: Reserve the charcoal field for the cover variant and rose for navigation state and interaction. Make links distinct through color and weight, with italic weight-600 anchors in prose and no underlines or decorative dividers; keep historical slate and orange out of ordinary small text.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Inter across every text role. Keep display typography light and lowercase, compact titles stronger, and sustained prose regular; establish hierarchy with the existing role scale and spacing.

rules.name: The Honest Gutter Rule
rules.body: The desktop columns share one layout gap. Do not add sidebar padding that doubles the visible gutter; the dark feature has its own internal padding.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Separate functions with continuous space, typography, and the charcoal cover field. Keep supporting stories and lists on the page ground without decorative rules, drop shadows, or floating cards.

dos: Do author tokens in the canonical CSS, build the inventories, and then refresh this derived record.
Do preserve the unequal editorial columns, one layout gutter, and source-order responsive stack.
Do keep display and navigation light, regular prose readable, and prose links distinct through italic weight 600.
Do keep wordmark, display-title, navigation, and prose-link weights stable on hover; distinguish current navigation with its established weight 600.
Do preserve optional images, wrapping titles, and the established article reading measure.
Do use descriptive links, semantic headings, native navigation, the skip link, and the existing visible focus treatment.
Do retain the Inter OFL license and exact asset provenance when distributing the optional font.
Do keep specimen stories and authors clearly identified as fictional.
donts: Don't introduce an independent palette, font ramp, or layout in Tailwind or an adapter.
Don't turn the light collection view into a media-player clone, generic tile dashboard, or promotional card gallery.
Don't distribute the reference screenshots, Microsoft marks, proprietary fonts, or borrowed media artwork.
Don't add divider lines, link underlines, fake strokes, rounded containers, drop shadows, or invented interface primitives to this vocabulary.
Don't require JavaScript, a framework, Node, or the optional font for a reader to use the core layout.
Don't assume inherited aliases recompute after a descendant-only primitive override; redeclare dependent aliases in the same scope.
Don't treat this record, its preview ramps, or source contrast calculations as a compatibility or accessibility certification.
